caption: The drawing depicts a stringed musical instrument with a rectangular wooden body that is light brown in color. On the upper surface of the instrument, there are keys, which appear to be arranged in a single row, alternating between white and black, resembling a keyboard. There is also a circular sound hole located slightly to the right of center, with several strings running lengthwise from the left end to tuning pegs on the right end of the instrument. The tuning pegs are visible on the side and are dark in color. The entire object is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional elements or objects present.
title: Psalmodicon
